    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      从接口复制的说明: Cancellable
      Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins 获取此事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件
      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      true if this event is cancelled 此事件已取消则为 true

    • setCancelled

      public void setCancelled(boolean cancel)
      从接口复制的说明: Cancellable
      Sets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins. 设置此事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件。
      指定者:
      setCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      参数:
      cancel - true if you wish to cancel this event 若希望取消此事件则为 true

      public void setDamage(EntityDamageEvent.DamageModifier type, double damage) throws IllegalArgumentException, UnsupportedOperationException
      Sets the damage for the specified modifier. 设置指定修饰符的伤害值。

    • isApplicable

      public boolean isApplicable(EntityDamageEvent.DamageModifier type) throws IllegalArgumentException
      This checks to see if a particular modifier is valid for this event's caller, such that, setDamage(DamageModifier, double) will not throw an UnsupportedOperationException. 此方法用于检查某个修饰符对该事件的调用者是否有效，即 setDamage(DamageModifier, double) 是否不会抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

      EntityDamageEvent.DamageModifier.BASE is always applicable. EntityDamageEvent.DamageModifier.BASE 始终适用。

      参数:
      type - the modifier 修饰符
      返回:
      true if the modifier is supported by the caller, false otherwise 若调用者支持该修饰符则为 true，否则为 false
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if type is null 若 type 为 null

    • setDamage

      public void setDamage(double damage)
      Sets the raw amount of damage caused by the event. 设置该事件造成的原始伤害值。

      For compatibility this also recalculates the modifiers and scales them by the difference between the modifier for the previous damage value and the new one. 为保持兼容，此方法还会重新计算各修饰符，并按先前伤害值与新伤害值之间的差值对其进行缩放。

      参数:
      damage - The raw amount of damage caused by the event 该事件造成的原始伤害值
